import subprocess, os
a = open('samples/a.bin','rb').read(); b = open('samples/b.bin','rb').read()
MASK = 0xFFFFFFFF
def sums(x):
    body = x[:-4]
    stored = int.from_bytes(x[-4:], 'little')
    s = sum(body) & MASK
    x32 = 0
    for i in range(0, len(body), 4):
        x32 ^= int.from_bytes(body[i:i+4].ljust(4, b'\x00'), 'little')
    print('len%d stored=%08x sum32=%08x xor32=%08x' % (len(x), stored, s, x32))
sums(a); sums(b)
os.makedirs('/tmp/p', exist_ok=True)
def run(d, n):
    open('/tmp/p/'+n,'wb').write(d)
    print('%-14s' % n, subprocess.run(['./reader','/tmp/p/'+n],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip()[:60])
# checksum tamper
m = bytearray(a); m[-1] ^= 1; run(bytes(m), 'ckflip')
m = bytearray(a); m[-4] ^= 1; run(bytes(m), 'ckflip4')
# pad/version
m = bytearray(a); m[5] = 1; run(bytes(m), 'pad1')
m = bytearray(a); m[4] = 0x4a; run(bytes(m), 'ver+1')
# count0: header through source byte, count=0, then recompute checksum over that body
body = a[:5] + b'\x00' + a[7:15]
ck = (sum(body) & MASK).to_bytes(4,'little')
run(body + ck, 'count0')
# charset in ts string (offset 16)
for c in [0x1f, 0x20, 0x7e, 0x7f]:
    m = bytearray(a); m[16] = c
    body = bytes(m[:-4]); run(body + (sum(body)&MASK).to_bytes(4,'little'), 'ts%02x'%c)
